scope: Initial publication proposal selected from the 500-candidate research batch. This is listing eligibility review, not product execution or a security audit. No wallet, login, download, payment or transaction was used.
audit_status: Every proposed listing is pending_audit. Unknown founding year, country, token and social details retain the existing n/a/Metaverse policy values.

remaining_candidates.note: Not included in this release proposal. Availability screening covered all 500; full individual content review is not complete for the remainder. Aliases, unclear product status, scope changes and access failures require follow-up.

known_holds.aero-slipstream: Aerodrome/Aero project-family overlap; update or reconcile the existing entry before adding another.
known_holds.autofinance: Tokemak/Auto Finance rebrand overlaps an existing listing.
known_holds.sparklend: Spark already exists; this protocol-family alias should not create a duplicate.
known_holds.superfluid: Existing Superfluid Governance listing requires reconciliation before another project entry.
known_holds.yearn-curating: Yearn Finance already exists under a different domain.
known_holds.cyber: Official site announces wallet sunsetting; current live product scope needs fresh review.
known_holds.xion-finance: Research URL now redirects to Verona; identity and project continuity need review.
known_holds.elsa: Official app returned HTTP 403 to the read-only check; availability needs browser confirmation.
known_holds.griffin-ai: Official app returned HTTP 403; product availability needs browser confirmation.
known_holds.pieverse: Product page reports wallet services could not start; product acceptance remains held.
known_holds.zama: Official app returned HTTP 429; avoid repeated requests and review later.
known_holds.openserv: Current homepage emphasizes general AI infrastructure; verify a current explicit onchain product before classifying under crypto/Web3 AI Agents.
known_holds.turbo-loop: Fixed-duration yield and referral claims require exclusion-criteria review; no listing proposed.
known_holds.hydration-lending: Hydration is the current HydraDX project; reconcile the existing HydraDX listing rather than add a duplicate.
